title: 工業數位分身資料平台
subcategoryTitle: 神經網路、資料與視覺系統
subcategoryTitleEn: Neural networks, data and visual systems
summary: 以物理狀態、事件資料與分身一致性串連 16 個原創技術單元、32 步；涵蓋原理解析、架構圖、假想量化、合成資料實驗、競爭失效原因及可重算驗收。
summaryEn: Sixteen original technical units and 32 tasks connect physical state, event data and twin consistency with principles, architectures, assumed calculations, synthetic experiments, competing failure causes and reproducible acceptance.
scope: 公開原理的本地科教模擬與工程判讀。只使用自製、合成或明確授權的資料；不操作真實受害主機、他人帳號、工業控制或超算設施。數值不代表廠商規格或實測效能，完成課程不是專業資格、真實裝置操作經歷或生產部署認證。
scopeEn: Local educational simulation and engineering interpretation of public principles. Use self-made, synthetic or explicitly licensed data only; do not operate real victim hosts, other accounts, industrial control or supercomputing facilities. Values are not product specifications or measured performance. Completion is not a qualification, real-equipment experience or production-deployment certification.

stages.title: 實體與語意
stages.description: 四個技術單元依序完成「實體與語意」的架構與證據，共八步可分別儲存的本地科教實作。
stages.descriptionEn: Four technical units develop entities and semantics through eight separately saved local educational tasks.

steps.title: 實體標識：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「實體標識」建立原理、介面與可反駁模型。
steps.objectiveEn: Build principles, interfaces and a falsifiable model for entity identifiers.
steps.instruction: 先觀察師傅的「實體標識」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：物理裝置與數字實體需穩定對映。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「給三臺玩具裝置建序號與分身 ID。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for entity identifiers. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Physical devices need stable mappings to digital entities. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Map serials and twin IDs for three toy devices. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.
steps.observation: 給三臺玩具裝置建序號與分身 ID。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Map serials and twin IDs for three toy devices. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：裝置換名就必須成為同一個舊分身。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Renaming a device guarantees identity with an old twin. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「實體標識」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「給三臺玩具裝置建序號與分身 ID。」如何辨別它們。
steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case architecture, assumptions and falsifiable prediction for entity identifiers; explain how the proposed evidence discriminates the cases.

knowledge.title: 原理與架構依據
knowledge.text: 物理裝置與數字實體需穩定對映。
knowledge.textEn: Physical devices need stable mappings to digital entities.

knowledge.title: 辨別模型的證據
knowledge.text: 給三臺玩具裝置建序號與分身 ID。 保留基準、輸入版本、單位與誤差範圍；這項證據只支援已列出的模型邊界，不能自動推廣為整套真實系統保證。
knowledge.textEn: Map serials and twin IDs for three toy devices. Preserve baselines, input versions, units and errors; this evidence supports stated model boundaries, not an automatic guarantee for an entire real system.

knowledge.title: 本課量化算例
knowledge.text: 假想溫度感測器每秒 10 次、每筆 40 bytes，1000 個感測器原始資料率=400000 bytes/s，約 0.4 MB/s；一天 34.56 GB 十進位。訊息封裝、索引、副本和重送不在此值內。
knowledge.textEn: A synthetic fleet of 1,000 sensors at 10 samples/s and 40 bytes/sample produces 400,000 bytes/s or 34.56 decimal GB/day, before message framing, indexes, replication and retries.

quiz.question: 審查「實體標識」的原理與架構時，哪個說法成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which principle/architecture claim is justified for entity identifiers?
options: 裝置換名就必須成為同一個舊分身。
物理裝置與數字實體需穩定對映。
只要一次輸出符合預期，就能推定「實體標識」對所有資料量、版本與故障條件都成立。
optionsEn: Renaming a device guarantees identity with an old twin.
Physical devices need stable mappings to digital entities.
One matching output proves entity identifiers for all sizes, versions and failure conditions.
quiz.explanation: 物理裝置與數字實體需穩定對映。 給三臺玩具裝置建序號與分身 ID。 因此「裝置換名就必須成為同一個舊分身。」混淆了本單元必須分開檢查的條件。
quiz.explanationEn: Physical devices need stable mappings to digital entities. Map serials and twin IDs for three toy devices. The alternative "Renaming a device guarantees identity with an old twin." conflates conditions that must be checked separately.

steps.title: 實體標識：實驗與證據
steps.objective: 以「實體標識」建立可重算實驗、錯誤辨識與驗收證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Build reproducible experiments, diagnosis and acceptance evidence for entity identifiers.
steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意後，僅在自製資料、副本或本地合成環境驗證，不連線真實目標、不取得旁人資料。實作：「給三臺玩具裝置建序號與分身 ID。」；將結果與「物理裝置與數字實體需穩定對映。」逐項對照。保留基準和變更後輸出，先列至少兩個可能造成差異的原因，再用版本、單位、誤差或信任邊界排除其中一項。未有實測的數值須明寫為假想值。最後寫出透過／保留的理由和仍待驗證條件。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit, then validate only self-made data, copies or a local synthetic environment; do not connect to real targets or collect other people's data. Exercise: Map serials and twin IDs for three toy devices. Compare results against: Physical devices need stable mappings to digital entities. Preserve baseline and changed outputs. List at least two competing causes and discriminate one using versions, units, errors or trust boundaries. Label unmeasured values hypothetical. Document pass/hold reasons and remaining conditions.
steps.observation: 給三臺玩具裝置建序號與分身 ID。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Map serials and twin IDs for three toy devices. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：裝置換名就必須成為同一個舊分身。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Renaming a device guarantees identity with an old twin. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「實體標識」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「裝置換名就必須成為同一個舊分身。」為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: Submit outputs, baseline differences, rejected misconceptions and limits for entity identifiers; explain why this claim fails: Renaming a device guarantees identity with an old twin.

steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意後，僅在自製資料、副本或本地合成環境驗證，不連線真實目標、不取得旁人資料。實作：「比較攝氏與開爾文的玩具資料轉換。」；將結果與「單位、座標與時間基準是資料語意的一部分。」逐項對照。保留基準和變更後輸出，先列至少兩個可能造成差異的原因，再用版本、單位、誤差或信任邊界排除其中一項。未有實測的數值須明寫為假想值。最後寫出透過／保留的理由和仍待驗證條件。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit, then validate only self-made data, copies or a local synthetic environment; do not connect to real targets or collect other people's data. Exercise: Compare Celsius and kelvin conversions in toy data. Compare results against: Units, coordinates and clocks are part of semantics. Preserve baseline and changed outputs. List at least two competing causes and discriminate one using versions, units, errors or trust boundaries. Label unmeasured values hypothetical. Document pass/hold reasons and remaining conditions.
steps.observation: 比較攝氏與開爾文的玩具資料轉換。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Compare Celsius and kelvin conversions in toy data. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：欄位名稱溫度足以辨識其單位。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: A temperature field name identifies its units. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「測量單位」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「欄位名稱溫度足以辨識其單位。」為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: Submit outputs, baseline differences, rejected misconceptions and limits for measurement units; explain why this claim fails: A temperature field name identifies its units.

knowledge.title: 原理與架構依據
knowledge.text: 單位、座標與時間基準是資料語意的一部分。
knowledge.textEn: Units, coordinates and clocks are part of semantics.

knowledge.title: 辨別模型的證據
knowledge.text: 比較攝氏與開爾文的玩具資料轉換。 保留基準、輸入版本、單位與誤差範圍；這項證據只支援已列出的模型邊界，不能自動推廣為整套真實系統保證。
knowledge.textEn: Compare Celsius and kelvin conversions in toy data. Preserve baselines, input versions, units and errors; this evidence supports stated model boundaries, not an automatic guarantee for an entire real system.

quiz.question: 審查「測量單位」的驗證方法時，哪個說法成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which validation approach is justified for measurement units?
options: 比較攝氏與開爾文的玩具資料轉換。
欄位名稱溫度足以辨識其單位。
先把「測量單位」的顯示結果調到符合預期，再把這次吻合當作獨立驗證。
optionsEn: Compare Celsius and kelvin conversions in toy data.
A temperature field name identifies its units.
Tune the displayed measurement units result to the expected value and count that agreement as independent validation.
quiz.explanation: 單位、座標與時間基準是資料語意的一部分。 比較攝氏與開爾文的玩具資料轉換。 因此「欄位名稱溫度足以辨識其單位。」混淆了本單元必須分開檢查的條件。
quiz.explanationEn: Units, coordinates and clocks are part of semantics. Compare Celsius and kelvin conversions in toy data. The alternative "A temperature field name identifies its units." conflates conditions that must be checked separately.

steps.title: 時間版本：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「時間版本」建立原理、介面與可反駁模型。
steps.objectiveEn: Build principles, interfaces and a falsifiable model for temporal versions.
steps.instruction: 先觀察師傅的「時間版本」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：觀測時刻與入庫時刻需分開。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「模擬遲到資料與最新狀態更新。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for temporal versions. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Observation and ingestion times are distinct. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Simulate late data and latest-state updates. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.
steps.observation: 模擬遲到資料與最新狀態更新。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Simulate late data and latest-state updates. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：最後到達的記錄必然代表最新物理狀態。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: The latest arrival always represents the latest physical state. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「時間版本」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「模擬遲到資料與最新狀態更新。」如何辨別它們。
steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case architecture, assumptions and falsifiable prediction for temporal versions; explain how the proposed evidence discriminates the cases.

knowledge.title: 原理與架構依據
knowledge.text: 觀測時刻與入庫時刻需分開。
knowledge.textEn: Observation and ingestion times are distinct.

knowledge.title: 辨別模型的證據
knowledge.text: 模擬遲到資料與最新狀態更新。 保留基準、輸入版本、單位與誤差範圍；這項證據只支援已列出的模型邊界，不能自動推廣為整套真實系統保證。
knowledge.textEn: Simulate late data and latest-state updates. Preserve baselines, input versions, units and errors; this evidence supports stated model boundaries, not an automatic guarantee for an entire real system.

quiz.question: 審查「時間版本」的原理與架構時，哪個說法成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which principle/architecture claim is justified for temporal versions?
options: 最後到達的記錄必然代表最新物理狀態。
觀測時刻與入庫時刻需分開。
只要一次輸出符合預期，就能推定「時間版本」對所有資料量、版本與故障條件都成立。
optionsEn: The latest arrival always represents the latest physical state.
Observation and ingestion times are distinct.
One matching output proves temporal versions for all sizes, versions and failure conditions.
quiz.explanation: 觀測時刻與入庫時刻需分開。 模擬遲到資料與最新狀態更新。 因此「最後到達的記錄必然代表最新物理狀態。」混淆了本單元必須分開檢查的條件。
quiz.explanationEn: Observation and ingestion times are distinct. Simulate late data and latest-state updates. The alternative "The latest arrival always represents the latest physical state." conflates conditions that must be checked separately.
